data.name: UnableToLoadMessage

data.value: The exact resource identity could not be resolved in its owner scope.

data.name: ResourceIdentityHelp
data.value: Access grants are bound to this exact resource and never fall back by name.

data.name: ManagedResourceHelp
data.value: The definition and supplied version are controlled by its management authority. Local access grants remain independently editable.

data.name: EditableResourceHelp
data.value: The definition and its local access policy are administered independently.

data.name: DefaultDenyHelp
data.value: Higher-scope resources are unavailable to descendants by default. Add an exact grant or explicitly propagate it to lower descendants.

data.name: NoGrantsMessage
data.value: This resource can currently be used only from its owner scope.

data.value: You can inspect this policy, but you are not authorized to change grants in the owner scope.

data.name: GrantActionsRequired
data.value: Every grant must allow Discover, Use, or both.

data.name: InvalidTarget
data.value: Select a valid descendant scope. Owner, parent, sibling, and unrelated scopes cannot receive this grant.

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: The access policy could not be saved. Refresh it and verify your authorization before trying again.
